vocabmatch.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: with a lot of work and no free time
a conversation by phone or by video
one piece of work that you must do
a person who works with you
a big piece of work with a goal and an end date

listenings.text: Every week at Sucafina is different, but some things are always the same. Every Monday I check my email and I review the IMS system. On Tuesdays I usually visit a farm. But this week is not a normal week. This week I am working on a new project. I am preparing the EUDR maps for twelve farms in the south of Minas Gerais. My colleague Ana is helping me. She is checking the documents of the producers, and I am drawing the farm boundaries. It is a busy week, but the project is going well.

Hi Carlos, this is Emma. I know you are very busy this week, so this is a short message. Right now I am reading your first maps, and they look very good. Thank you. My team in Geneva is preparing the report for the buyers, and we need two more maps by Thursday. Usually we talk on Fridays, but this week, can we have a call on Wednesday morning? Please send me a message when you can. Thank you, Carlos. Talk soon.

extra_audio.text: First, every Monday morning, I check my email and I review the IMS system. Then, this week, I am working on a new EUDR project. Next, right now, my colleague Ana is checking the documents of the producers. After that, at eleven, I have a call with Emma in Geneva. Finally, today I am not visiting farms, because I am preparing the maps.
